transcript:
: What would have helped you in that moment?

[10:05:28] System audio: A naïve answer is still an answer. Give me anything I can say out loud that is not a guess. Even « about an hour » would do.

[10:05:48] Microphone: Did the café next door idea ever go anywhere, sending people there to wait?

[10:06:15] System audio: We tried it for two weeks. People liked it 👍🏽 but two of them missed their turn, so the doctor said no more.

[10:06:49] Microphone: Who else should we talk to?

[10:07:07] System audio: Talk to Dr. François Lefèvre. He was the one who stopped it, and he will tell you why in more words than I can.

[10:07:32] Microphone: Thank you, Zoë. This was very useful.

[10:08:04] System audio: De nada. Come by the clínica any time. ☕
